facts.text: Cynthiana was founded in 1797 by Robert Harrison, who named the town after his daughters Cynthia and Ana.
The 3M factory in Cynthiana produced the world’s first Post‑it notes until the late 1990s, making the town a key spot in office‑supplies history.
Two Civil War battles took place in Cynthiana, including a July 1862 cavalry raid by Confederate General John Hunt Morgan and a 1864 Union victory over his forces.
In 1877, a meteorite fell on the South Fork of the Licking River near Cynthiana, a rare celestial event for the region.
Cynthiana is the hometown of comic‑book creator Robert Kirkman, who co‑created The Walking Dead, and the town hosts a historic Rohs Opera House.
The historic Cynthiana Jail, built in 1886, sits downtown beside the Sheriff’s Department and reflects the town’s 19th‑century civic architecture.
